name: Edamame Avocado Bowl
ingredients: Dressing: 1 tbsp soy sauce, juice of 1 lime, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 tsp rice vinegar
steps: Cook the edamame in boiling water for 4 minutes; drain and cool.
Divide the rice between two bowls.
Arrange the edamame, avocado, cucumber, carrot and cabbage on top.
Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with chilli flakes.
note: Edamame is a complete plant protein; avocado supplies mostly unsaturated fat.
